notes: 修复「同步报错却显示已完成（已推送）」：执行体没真正跑起来时，PowerShell 只把红字喷到控制台，$LASTEXITCODE 仍是上一条命令残留的 0，结果文件就写成 ok:true 并刷新同步分水岭，面板从此不再提示待推送，本机改动静默滞留。现在调用前先压哨兵值、用 try/catch 兜住终止错误并写进日志、没跑完一律判失败；调用前还会确认执行体文件仍存在（安装覆盖到一半也能拦住）；同步失败时不刷新分水岭，宁可多报一次待推送，也不让失败变成静默丢数据。
notesEn: Fixes the case where a sync reported success while nothing was actually pushed: when the executor never really started, PowerShell only printed a red error and left $LASTEXITCODE at the stale 0 of the previous command, so the result file said ok:true and the sync watermark was refreshed - after which the panel never warned about pending local changes again. The call now primes a sentinel exit code, wraps the invocation in try/catch and logs the error message, position and stack, treats any incomplete run as failure, re-checks that the executor file still exists before calling it, and skips the watermark refresh on failure - an extra pending-push hint is better than silently losing data.
